question: After keeping Step Plan on its currently documented Step 3.5 default, should fresh standard StepFun setups move to Step 3.7 Flash?
rationale: Step 3.7 is available on the standard provider, but the merged catalog work intentionally preserved Step 3.5; choosing the recommended onboarding model affects new-user provider behavior and requires owner intent.

options.title: Split the rollout
options.body: Default standard StepFun to Step 3.7 while retaining Step Plan on Step 3.5 until its provider contract changes.

options.title: Preserve both defaults
options.body: Keep both fresh onboarding paths on Step 3.5 and leave Step 3.7 as an explicit user selection.

options.title: Wait for provider alignment
options.body: Pause both default changes until StepFun publishes and live-verifies a consistent recommendation across standard and Step Plan.

recommendation.title: Split the rollout
recommendation.body: Default standard StepFun to Step 3.7 while retaining Step Plan on Step 3.5 until its provider contract changes.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR discussion explicitly requests this person’s decision on the provider-default policy.
